entry.prerequisite: Only completing the actual Idris meeting unlocks the lesson. An unfinished meeting leaves it hidden.

asserted.scene_copy: Production mission entry, title, kicker, both exact paragraphs and the sole locked choice. The design reference stays out of the game.
asserted.completion: The action stays hidden on completion, the next day and after save restoration.
asserted.journal: Existing goals remain indexed and visible. The lesson adds no chapter progress, side completion, goal progress, private counter or public account.

presentation: The Godot River Market runner uses its compact secondary choice. The master shows a full-width primary choice. Q15 assigns visual comparison to the design chat.
